name: Tessera Industries Quantum Dot Display Architecture
product_name: Tessera Industries Quantum Dot Display Architecture
description: A display technology using quantum dot emitters that can be printed onto any surface, turning walls, clothing, vehicles, and furniture into high-resolution displays. The quantum dots are suspended in a printable ink that, once applied and activated, produces vibrant, energy-efficient imagery at any scale. Tessera sells the ink through commercial channels, and the technology has transformed GLMZ's visual landscape — every surface is a potential screen, every building facade a billboard, and every garment a dynamic canvas.
social_impact: QDDA has made visual noise the default state of GLMZ's urban environment. Every surface competes for attention with animated advertisements, information displays, and artistic expressions. The technology has eliminated the concept of blank space in upper-tier districts while lower tiers use bootleg quantum dot ink for territorial marking and communication that authorities cannot paint over because it regenerates.
story_hooks: Quantum dot displays across a Tier 3 district simultaneously displayed a classified corporate document — someone hacked the display network to whistleblow on a massive scale.
A new quantum dot ink formulation has been developed that is invisible until activated by a specific signal — messages can be hidden on any surface, waiting to be revealed.
